diff --git a/tests/test_key_panel_tooltip_alignment.py b/tests/test_key_panel_tooltip_alignment.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..77b7d3c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_key_panel_tooltip_alignment.py
@@ -0,0 +1,425 @@
+"""The key panel must not pad a tooltip that has no description in front of it.
+
+`render_description` in the key panel joins a binding's *description* and its
+*tooltip* with a single space.  When a binding carries **only** a tooltip there
+is nothing to join it to, so the separator must not be emitted: otherwise every
+description-less row is pushed one cell to the right of the description column
+and the panel stops lining up.
+
+Two completely disjoint palettes are exercised:
+
+* an *archive browser* whose bindings live on the **App** and whose panel is
+  raised through ``action_show_help_panel()`` (the ``HelpPanel`` route), at
+  160x40; and
+* a *query pane* whose bindings live on a focused **widget** and whose panel is
+  a directly mounted ``KeyPanel``, at 120x26.
+
+They share no key, no size, no widget tree, no wording and no binding host, so a
+fix keyed on any of those cannot satisfy both.  Every expectation is recomputed
+at run time from the bindings the live application actually reports -- nothing
+is transcribed from a screenshot or a stored baseline, and no snapshot is
+involved.
+
+Both a state view (the Rich table the panel renders) and a behavioural view (the
+text and segments the compositor actually paints) are asserted.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from rich.table import Table
+from rich.text import Text
+
+from textual.app import App, ComposeResult
+from textual.binding import Binding
+from textual.containers import Horizontal, Vertical
+from textual.widgets import KeyPanel, Static
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
+# helpers
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
+
+
+def _bindings_table(app: App) -> Table:
+    """The Rich table the key panel renders for the current bindings."""
+    panel = app.query_one(KeyPanel)
+    for node in panel.walk_children(with_self=True):
+        renderer = getattr(node, "render_bindings_table", None)
+        if renderer is not None:
+            table = renderer()
+            assert isinstance(table, Table), "the key panel must render a Rich table"
+            return table
+    raise AssertionError("the key panel does not contain a bindings table")
+
+
+def _cell_text(cell: object) -> Text:
+    """Normalise a Rich table cell to a `Text`."""
+    return cell if isinstance(cell, Text) else Text(str(cell))
+
+
+def _description_cells(app: App) -> dict[str, Text]:
+    """Map every keyed row of the panel to its description cell.
+
+    Group-title rows (which have an empty key cell) are skipped.
+    """
+    table = _bindings_table(app)
+    assert len(table.columns) == 2, "the bindings table has a key and a description column"
+    rows: dict[str, Text] = {}
+    for key_cell, description_cell in zip(
+        table.columns[0]._cells, table.columns[1]._cells
+    ):
+        key = _cell_text(key_cell).plain
+        if not key:
+            continue
+        assert key not in rows, f"duplicate key row {key!r}"
+        rows[key] = _cell_text(description_cell)
+    return rows
+
+
+def _title_cells(app: App) -> list[str]:
+    """The plain text of every group-title row (rows with no key)."""
+    table = _bindings_table(app)
+    return [
+        _cell_text(description_cell).plain
+        for key_cell, description_cell in zip(
+            table.columns[0]._cells, table.columns[1]._cells
+        )
+        if not _cell_text(key_cell).plain
+    ]
+
+
+def _own_bindings(app: App, action_prefix: str) -> list[Binding]:
+    """The non-system bindings this palette declares, as the app reports them."""
+    bindings = [
+        active.binding
+        for active in app.screen.active_bindings.values()
+        if active.binding.action.startswith(action_prefix) and not active.binding.system
+    ]
+    assert bindings, f"no active bindings for {action_prefix!r}"
+    return bindings
+
+
+def _expected_descriptions(app: App, action_prefix: str) -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Recompute, from the live bindings, what each description cell must read.
+
+    A description and a tooltip are separated by exactly one space; when either
+    is absent the other stands alone with no padding.
+    """
+    expected: dict[str, str] = {}
+    for binding in _own_bindings(app, action_prefix):
+        description = Text.from_markup(binding.description).plain
+        parts = [part for part in (description, binding.tooltip) if part]
+        expected[app.get_key_display(binding)] = " ".join(parts)
+    return expected
+
+
+def _screen_lines(app: App) -> list[str]:
+    """Every line of composited screen output, as plain text."""
+    return [strip.text for strip in app.screen._compositor.render_strips()]
+
+
+def _column_of(app: App, needle: str) -> int:
+    """The screen column at which `needle` is painted (it must appear once)."""
+    hits = [(y, line.index(needle)) for y, line in enumerate(_screen_lines(app)) if needle in line]
+    assert len(hits) == 1, f"expected {needle!r} to be painted exactly once, got {hits}"
+    return hits[0][1]
+
+
+def _style_mask(app: App, needle: str, attribute: str) -> tuple[str, list[bool]]:
+    """The painted row holding `needle`, plus a per-column flag for a style attribute.
+
+    Styling is read back from what the compositor actually paints, so a fix is free
+    to build the cell out of spans, out of a base style, or out of anything else.
+    """
+    for strip in app.screen._compositor.render_strips():
+        if needle not in strip.text:
+            continue
+        mask: list[bool] = []
+        for segment in strip:

268:                    "content": "from __future__ import annotations

from collections import defaultdict
from itertools import groupby
from operator import itemgetter
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from rich import box
from rich.table import Table
from rich.text import Text

from textual.app import ComposeResult
from textual.binding import Binding
from textual.containers import VerticalScroll
from textual.widgets import Static

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from textual.screen import Screen


class BindingsTable(Static):
    """A widget to display bindings."""

    COMPONENT_CLASSES = {
        "bindings-table--key",
        "bindings-table--description",
        "bindings-table--divider",
        "bindings-table--header",
    }

    DEFAULT_CSS = """
    BindingsTable {
        width: auto;
        height: auto;
    }
    """

    def render_bindings_table(self) -> Table:
        """Render a table with all the key bindings.

        Returns:
            A Rich Table.
        """

        bindings = self.screen.active_bindings.values()

        key_style = self.get_component_rich_style("bindings-table--key")
        divider_transparent = (
            self.get_component_styles("bindings-table--divider").color.a == 0
        )
        table = Table(
            padding=(0, 0),
            show_header=False,
            box=box.SIMPLE if divider_transparent else box.HORIZONTALS,
            border_style=self.get_component_rich_style("bindings-table--divider"),
        )
        table.add_column("", justify="right")

        header_style = self.get_component_rich_style("bindings-table--header")
        previous_namespace: object = None
        for namespace, _bindings in groupby(bindings, key=itemgetter(0)):
            table_bindings = list(_bindings)
            if not table_bindings:
                continue

            if namespace.BINDING_GROUP_TITLE:
                title = Text(namespace.BINDING_GROUP_TITLE, end="")
                title.stylize(header_style)
                table.add_row("", title)

            action_to_bindings: defaultdict[str, list[tuple[Binding, bool, str]]]
            action_to_bindings = defaultdict(list)
            for _, binding, enabled, tooltip in table_bindings:
                if not binding.system:
                    action_to_bindings[binding.action].append(
                        (binding, enabled, tooltip)
                    )

            description_style = self.get_component_rich_style(
                "bindings-table--description"
            )

            def render_description(binding: Binding) -> Text:
                """Render description text from a binding."""
                text = Text.from_markup(
                    binding.description, end="", style=description_style
                )
                if binding.tooltip:
                    text.append(" ")
                    text.append(binding.tooltip, "dim")
                return text

            get_key_display = self.app.get_key_display
            for multi_bindings in action_to_bindings.values():
                binding, enabled, tooltip = multi_bindings[0]
                keys_display = " ".join(
                    dict.fromkeys(  # Remove duplicates while preserving order
                        get_key_display(binding) for binding, _, _ in multi_bindings
                    )
                )
                table.add_row(
                    Text(keys_display, style=key_style),
                    render_description(binding),
                )
            if namespace != previous_namespace:
                table.add_section()

            previous_namespace = namespace

        return table

    def render(self) -> Table:
        return self.render_bindings_table()


class KeyPanel(VerticalScroll, can_focus=False):
    """
    Shows bindings for currently focused widget.
    """

    DEFAULT_CSS = """
    KeyPanel {                    
        split: right;
        width: 33%;
        min-width: 30;              
        max-width: 60;    
        border-left: vkey $foreground 30%;
        padding: 0 1;
        height: 1fr;
        padding-right: 1;
        align: center top;

        &> BindingsTable > .bindings-table--key {
            color: $accent;           
            text-style: bold;
            padding: 0 1;
        }

        &> BindingsTable > .bindings-table--description {
            color: $foreground;
        }

        &> BindingsTable > .bindings-table--divider {
            color: transparent;
        }

        &> BindingsTable > .bindings-table--header {
            text-style: dim italic;
        }

        #bindings-table {
            width: auto;
            height: auto;
        }      
    }
    """

    DEFAULT_CLASSES = "-textual-system"

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        yield BindingsTable(shrink=True, expand=False)

    async def on_mount(self) -> None:
        async def bindings_changed(screen: Screen) -> None:
            if not screen.app.app_focus:
                return
            if self.is_attached and screen is self.screen:
                self.refresh(recompose=True)

        self.set_class(self.app.ansi_color, "-ansi-scrollbar")
        self.screen.bindings_updated_signal.subscribe(self, bindings_changed)

    def on_unmount(self) -> None:
        self.screen.bindings_updated_signal.unsubscribe(self)

268:                    "content": "from __future__ import annotations

from collections import defaultdict
from itertools import groupby
from operator import itemgetter
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from rich import box
from rich.table import Table
from rich.text import Text

from textual.app import ComposeResult
from textual.binding import Binding
from textual.containers import VerticalScroll
from textual.widgets import Static

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from textual.screen import Screen


class BindingsTable(Static):
    """A widget to display bindings."""

    COMPONENT_CLASSES = {
        "bindings-table--key",
        "bindings-table--description",
        "bindings-table--divider",
        "bindings-table--header",
    }

    DEFAULT_CSS = """
    BindingsTable {
        width: auto;
        height: auto;
    }
    """

    def render_bindings_table(self) -> Table:
        """Render a table with all the key bindings.

        Returns:
            A Rich Table.
        """

        bindings = self.screen.active_bindings.values()

        key_style = self.get_component_rich_style("bindings-table--key")
        divider_transparent = (
            self.get_component_styles("bindings-table--divider").color.a == 0
        )
        table = Table(
            padding=(0, 0),
            show_header=False,
            box=box.SIMPLE if divider_transparent else box.HORIZONTALS,
            border_style=self.get_component_rich_style("bindings-table--divider"),
        )
        table.add_column("", justify="right")

        header_style = self.get_component_rich_style("bindings-table--header")
        previous_namespace: object = None
        for namespace, _bindings in groupby(bindings, key=itemgetter(0)):
            table_bindings = list(_bindings)
            if not table_bindings:
                continue

            if namespace.BINDING_GROUP_TITLE:
                title = Text(namespace.BINDING_GROUP_TITLE, end="")
                title.stylize(header_style)
                table.add_row("", title)

            action_to_bindings: defaultdict[str, list[tuple[Binding, bool, str]]]
            action_to_bindings = defaultdict(list)
            for _, binding, enabled, tooltip in table_bindings:
                if not binding.system:
                    action_to_bindings[binding.action].append(
                        (binding, enabled, tooltip)
                    )

            description_style = self.get_component_rich_style(
                "bindings-table--description"
            )

            def render_description(binding: Binding) -> Text:
                """Render description text from a binding."""
                text = Text.from_markup(
                    binding.description, end="", style=description_style
                )
                if binding.tooltip:
                    text.append(" ")
                    text.append(binding.tooltip, "dim")
                return text

            get_key_display = self.app.get_key_display
            for multi_bindings in action_to_bindings.values():
                binding, enabled, tooltip = multi_bindings[0]
                keys_display = " ".join(
                    dict.fromkeys(  # Remove duplicates while preserving order
                        get_key_display(binding) for binding, _, _ in multi_bindings
                    )
                )
                table.add_row(
                    Text(keys_display, style=key_style),
                    render_description(binding),
                )
            if namespace != previous_namespace:
                table.add_section()

            previous_namespace = namespace

        return table

    def render(self) -> Table:
        return self.render_bindings_table()


class KeyPanel(VerticalScroll, can_focus=False):
    """
    Shows bindings for currently focused widget.
    """

    DEFAULT_CSS = """
    KeyPanel {                    
        split: right;
        width: 33%;
        min-width: 30;              
        max-width: 60;    
        border-left: vkey $foreground 30%;
        padding: 0 1;
        height: 1fr;
        padding-right: 1;
        align: center top;

        &> BindingsTable > .bindings-table--key {
            color: $accent;           
            text-style: bold;
            padding: 0 1;
        }

        &> BindingsTable > .bindings-table--description {
            color: $foreground;
        }

        &> BindingsTable > .bindings-table--divider {
            color: transparent;
        }

        &> BindingsTable > .bindings-table--header {
            text-style: dim italic;
        }

        #bindings-table {
            width: auto;
            height: auto;
        }      
    }
    """

    DEFAULT_CLASSES = "-textual-system"

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        yield BindingsTable(shrink=True, expand=False)

    async def on_mount(self) -> None:
        async def bindings_changed(screen: Screen) -> None:
            if not screen.app.app_focus:
                return
            if self.is_attached and screen is self.screen:
                self.refresh(recompose=True)

        self.set_class(self.app.ansi_color, "-ansi-scrollbar")
        self.screen.bindings_updated_signal.subscribe(self, bindings_changed)

    def on_unmount(self) -> None:
        self.screen.bindings_updated_signal.unsubscribe(self)

268:                    "content": "from __future__ import annotations

from collections import defaultdict
from itertools import groupby
from operator import itemgetter
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from rich import box
from rich.table import Table
from rich.text import Text

from textual.app import ComposeResult
from textual.binding import Binding
from textual.containers import VerticalScroll
from textual.widgets import Static

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from textual.screen import Screen


class BindingsTable(Static):
    """A widget to display bindings."""

    COMPONENT_CLASSES = {
        "bindings-table--key",
        "bindings-table--description",
        "bindings-table--divider",
        "bindings-table--header",
    }

    DEFAULT_CSS = """
    BindingsTable {
        width: auto;
        height: auto;
    }
    """

    def render_bindings_table(self) -> Table:
        """Render a table with all the key bindings.

        Returns:
            A Rich Table.
        """

        bindings = self.screen.active_bindings.values()

        key_style = self.get_component_rich_style("bindings-table--key")
        divider_transparent = (
            self.get_component_styles("bindings-table--divider").color.a == 0
        )
        table = Table(
            padding=(0, 0),
            show_header=False,
            box=box.SIMPLE if divider_transparent else box.HORIZONTALS,
            border_style=self.get_component_rich_style("bindings-table--divider"),
        )
        table.add_column("", justify="right")

        header_style = self.get_component_rich_style("bindings-table--header")
        previous_namespace: object = None
        for namespace, _bindings in groupby(bindings, key=itemgetter(0)):
            table_bindings = list(_bindings)
            if not table_bindings:
                continue

            if namespace.BINDING_GROUP_TITLE:
                title = Text(namespace.BINDING_GROUP_TITLE, end="")
                title.stylize(header_style)
                table.add_row("", title)

            action_to_bindings: defaultdict[str, list[tuple[Binding, bool, str]]]
            action_to_bindings = defaultdict(list)
            for _, binding, enabled, tooltip in table_bindings:
                if not binding.system:
                    action_to_bindings[binding.action].append(
                        (binding, enabled, tooltip)
                    )

            description_style = self.get_component_rich_style(
                "bindings-table--description"
            )

            def render_description(binding: Binding) -> Text:
                """Render description text from a binding."""
                text = Text.from_markup(
                    binding.description, end="", style=description_style
                )
                if binding.tooltip:
                    text.append(" ")
                    text.append(binding.tooltip, "dim")
                return text

            get_key_display = self.app.get_key_display
            for multi_bindings in action_to_bindings.values():
                binding, enabled, tooltip = multi_bindings[0]
                keys_display = " ".join(
                    dict.fromkeys(  # Remove duplicates while preserving order
                        get_key_display(binding) for binding, _, _ in multi_bindings
                    )
                )
                table.add_row(
                    Text(keys_display, style=key_style),
                    render_description(binding),
                )
            if namespace != previous_namespace:
                table.add_section()

            previous_namespace = namespace

        return table

    def render(self) -> Table:
        return self.render_bindings_table()


class KeyPanel(VerticalScroll, can_focus=False):
    """
    Shows bindings for currently focused widget.
    """

    DEFAULT_CSS = """
    KeyPanel {                    
        split: right;
        width: 33%;
        min-width: 30;              
        max-width: 60;    
        border-left: vkey $foreground 30%;
        padding: 0 1;
        height: 1fr;
        padding-right: 1;
        align: center top;

        &> BindingsTable > .bindings-table--key {
            color: $accent;           
            text-style: bold;
            padding: 0 1;
        }

        &> BindingsTable > .bindings-table--description {
            color: $foreground;
        }

        &> BindingsTable > .bindings-table--divider {
            color: transparent;
        }

        &> BindingsTable > .bindings-table--header {
            text-style: dim italic;
        }

        #bindings-table {
            width: auto;
            height: auto;
        }      
    }
    """

    DEFAULT_CLASSES = "-textual-system"

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        yield BindingsTable(shrink=True, expand=False)

    async def on_mount(self) -> None:
        async def bindings_changed(screen: Screen) -> None:
            if not screen.app.app_focus:
                return
            if self.is_attached and screen is self.screen:
                self.refresh(recompose=True)

        self.set_class(self.app.ansi_color, "-ansi-scrollbar")
        self.screen.bindings_updated_signal.subscribe(self, bindings_changed)

    def on_unmount(self) -> None:
        self.screen.bindings_updated_signal.unsubscribe(self)

                """Render description text from a binding."""
                text = Text.from_markup(
                    binding.description, end="", style=description_style
                )

    DEFAULT_CSS = """
